answer: Each identity must own one hollow walnut-wood flute with an ivory mouthpiece, carved by hand and played before the warden each epoch: the warden records the tune and checks it against the flute's registered voice. A flute costs about $350 in wood and carving time, and the walnut groves are few, so each extra fake needs another scarce flute and pushes the price up; a copied flute fails because no two registered voices match.
